sections.title: باب 8 — متن (6)

paras.text: … so that the listener and viewer can understand quickly.
paras.urdu: حامل ہے تاکہ سننے اور دیکھنے والا جلدی سمجھ سکے۔
paras.pashto: … لري ترڅو اورېدونکی او لیدونکی ژر پوه شي.

paras.text: A public service message can prove effective when the presenter is a volunteer; when you have complete information about the problem; when a particular kind of reaction is expected; when you have skill in writing and production; when you have previously run this kind of message successfully; and when it is part of a big media campaign. Before writing this kind of message, find the answers to these questions.
paras.urdu: پبلک سروس میسج اُس وقت مؤثر ثابت ہو سکتا ہے جب پیش کرنے والا رضاکار ہو؛ جب آپ کو مسئلے پر مکمل معلومات حاصل ہوں؛ جب مخصوص قسم کے ردِعمل کی توقع ہو؛ جب آپ کو لکھنے اور پروڈکشن میں مہارت ہو؛ جب آپ پہلے اِس قسم کے پیغامات کامیابی سے چلا چکے ہوں اور جب یہ ایک بڑی میڈیا مہم کا حصہ ہو۔ اِس قسم کے پیغام کو تحریر کرنے سے پہلے اِن سوالات کے جوابات ڈھونڈیں۔

paras.text: The length of a public service message is ten, fifteen, twenty or thirty seconds, and in these durations the number of words is 20–25, 30–35, 40–50 and 60–75. Between words there is a pause of two or three times.
paras.urdu: ایک پبلک سروس پیغام کی لمبائی دس، پندرہ، بیس یا پھر تیس سیکنڈ ہوتی ہے اور اِن اوقات میں الفاظ کی تعداد 20-25، 30-35، 40-50 اور 60-75 ہوتی ہے۔ الفاظ میں دو دفعہ یا تین دفعہ کا وقفہ ہوتا ہے۔

paras.text: Title: Day of sympathy with people affected by AIDS.
paras.urdu: ٹائٹل: ایڈز سے متاثرہ لوگوں سے ہمدردی کا دن۔
paras.pashto: سرلیک: له ایډز ځپلو خلکو سره د خواخوږۍ ورځ.

paras.text: The day of sympathy with people affected by AIDS will be celebrated on 20 June. Today at the national level three hundred and twenty thousand people are AIDS-stricken; it may have happened to some relative of yours. On 20 June switch on your radio or TV and celebrate the day of sympathy with the victims of AIDS. Give protection to life, stay awake and stay safe.
paras.urdu: ایڈز سے متاثرہ لوگوں سے ہمدردی کا دن 20 جون کو منایا جائے گا آج قومی سطح پر تین لاکھ بیس ہزار لوگ ایڈز زدہ ہیں یہ آپ کے کسی عزیز کو ہو چکا ہوگا آپ 20 جون کو اپنا ریڈیو یا ٹی وی کھولئے اور ایڈز کے متاثرین سے ہمدردی کا دن منائیں زندگی کو تحفظ دو بیدار رہو اور محفوظ رہو۔

sections.theory:
… so that the listener and viewer can understand quickly.

A public service message can prove effective when the presenter is a volunteer; when you have complete information about the problem; when a particular kind of reaction is expected; when you have skill in writing and production; when you have previously run this kind of message successfully; and when it is part of a big media campaign. Before writing this kind of message, find the answers to these questions.

The length of a public service message is ten, fifteen, twenty or thirty seconds, and in these durations the number of words is 20–25, 30–35, 40–50 and 60–75. Between words there is a pause of two or three times.

The script is in two columns. The left column consists of instructions, direction, camera angles and sound effects etc., while the right column consists of dialogue. At the end of the script it is necessary to put this sign “###”, which means that there is no other page after it.

A sample of a standard radio message is this:

For immediate broadcast.  Time 30 seconds

Organisation: Organisation for Protection from AIDS.

Title: Day of sympathy with people affected by AIDS.

Important points:

The day of sympathy with people affected by AIDS will be celebrated on 20 June. Today at the national level three hundred and twenty thousand people are AIDS-stricken; it may have happened to some relative of yours. On 20 June switch on your radio or TV and celebrate the day of sympathy with the victims of AIDS. Give protection to life, stay awake and stay safe.

###

Activities

1. Identify such an important problem through which the public may be made able to solve the problem.

2. Compose such a slogan for television as is in the interest of the public.

سکرپٹ دو کالموں میں ہوتا ہے۔ بایاں کالم ہدایات، سمت، کیمرہ کے زاویئے اور آواز کے اثرات وغیرہ پر مشتمل ہوتا ہے جبکہ دایاں کالم ڈائیلاگ پر مشتمل ہوتا ہے۔ سکرپٹ کے آخر میں یہ نشان ”###“ لگانا ضروری ہے جس کا مطلب یہ ہے کہ اِس کے بعد کوئی اور صفحہ نہیں۔

ایک معیاری ریڈیو پیغام کا نمونہ یہ ہے:

ٹائٹل: ایڈز سے متاثرہ لوگوں سے ہمدردی کا دن۔

ایڈز سے متاثرہ لوگوں سے ہمدردی کا دن 20 جون کو منایا جائے گا آج قومی سطح پر تین لاکھ بیس ہزار لوگ ایڈز زدہ ہیں یہ آپ کے کسی عزیز کو ہو چکا ہوگا آپ 20 جون کو اپنا ریڈیو یا ٹی وی کھولئے اور ایڈز کے متاثرین سے ہمدردی کا دن منائیں زندگی کو تحفظ دو بیدار رہو اور محفوظ رہو۔

سرگرمیاں

sections.content:
… so that the listener and viewer can understand quickly.

A public service message can prove effective when the presenter is a volunteer; when you have complete information about the problem; when a particular kind of reaction is expected; when you have skill in writing and production; when you have previously run this kind of message successfully; and when it is part of a big media campaign. Before writing this kind of message, find the answers to these questions.

The length of a public service message is ten, fifteen, twenty or thirty seconds, and in these durations the number of words is 20–25, 30–35, 40–50 and 60–75. Between words there is a pause of two or three times.

The script is in two columns. The left column consists of instructions, direction, camera angles and sound effects etc., while the right column consists of dialogue. At the end of the script it is necessary to put this sign “###”, which means that there is no other page after it.

A sample of a standard radio message is this:

For immediate broadcast. Time 30 seconds

Organisation: Organisation for Protection from AIDS.

Title: Day of sympathy with people affected by AIDS.

Important points:

The day of sympathy with people affected by AIDS will be celebrated on 20 June. Today at the national level three hundred and twenty thousand people are AIDS-stricken; it may have happened to some relative of yours. On 20 June switch on your radio or TV and celebrate the day of sympathy with the victims of AIDS. Give protection to life, stay awake and stay safe.

###

Activities

1. Identify such an important problem through which the public may be made able to solve the problem.

2. Compose such a slogan for television as is in the interest of the public.

paras.text: A signature campaign is such a plan in which the signatures of the greatest number of people are obtained in favour of or against some issue, so that they gain awareness about the issue and pressure also increases on the concerned institutions. In Iran a powerful signature campaign was run for the rights of women. The campaign of one million signatures was run by Iranian women for the rights of women. In a political demonstration the participants can be beaten, suppressed or arrested, but in a signature campaign two or three workers go to cities and obtain signatures at shops, parks, recreational places, bus stops, schools and other public places. Suppressing this campaign is very difficult, because it is a peaceful and effective means of conveying one’s point to authorised people. In a signature campaign people are explained to face to face and then, according to their will, their signature is taken. In this way the message spreads to every corner of the country. Its most important purpose is to create awareness and feeling among people.

sections.content:
Signature Campaign

A signature campaign is such a plan in which the signatures of the greatest number of people are obtained in favour of or against some issue, so that they gain awareness about the issue and pressure also increases on the concerned institutions. In Iran a powerful signature campaign was run for the rights of women. The campaign of one million signatures was run by Iranian women for the rights of women. In a political demonstration the participants can be beaten, suppressed or arrested, but in a signature campaign two or three workers go to cities and obtain signatures at shops, parks, recreational places, bus stops, schools and other public places. Suppressing this campaign is very difficult, because it is a peaceful and effective means of conveying one’s point to authorised people. In a signature campaign people are explained to face to face and then, according to their will, their signature is taken. In this way the message spreads to every corner of the country. Its most important purpose is to create awareness and feeling among people.

A signature campaign of this same kind was run by the All Parties Hurriyat Conference, the representative party alliance of Kashmir. Its purpose was to draw the attention of American President Barack Hussain Obama to the Kashmir dispute. A spokesman of the All Parties Hurriyat Conference said in a statement that this campaign was run in Jammu and Azad Kashmir for two weeks. This document consisting of signatures was presented as a memorandum at the American Embassy in New Delhi.

Community Service

Community service means public service or activity based on donations. It is generally the activity of volunteers. But being a volunteer is also not necessary, because some people who join community service either take remuneration or have been bound to do so. For example, by some governments the compulsory responsibility of community service is placed on citizens. Military employees too are engaged in these activities.
